title: Transaction v1
description: A card transaction published to the `transactions` Kafka topic, keyed by cardId. Mirrors io.budget.watchdog.schema.Transaction; TransactionContractTest keeps the two in sync. Unknown extra fields are allowed.

transactionId.description: Unique per transaction; the idempotency key.

cardId.description: Card (or account) the transaction posted to. Also the Kafka key.

amountCents.description: Money out, except for INCOME, which is money in.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code. USD only in v1.

occurredAt.description: When it happened (event time). Rules use only this time.

publishedAt.description: Real time the source published it. End-to-end latency starts here.
